llm_response.reason: The website claims to be the official Dutch store for the Guess brand but has many signs of a scam: unusually low prices and discounts on every product (indicator 1), mimics the design of the official brand (indicator 16), domain does not match official Guess domains, offers multiple products and outlet discounts (indicator 5), lacks clear company registration, legitimate business contacts, and verifiable privacy/payment methods (indicators 4, 6, 7, 8). No reliable third-party reviews or company verification are present. These traits strongly indicate a fake online shopping scam.
